batch_prep.station: SAT NIGHT — DRY RUB WHOLE CHICKEN (5 min)
tasks: 1 whole chicken (4–5 lbs) — pat dry inside and out; apply dry rub all over skin AND under breast skin: 2 tbsp smoked paprika + 1 tbsp garlic powder + 1 tbsp brown sugar + 1 tsp cayenne + 1 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp kosher salt; wrap loosely in plastic wrap; refrigerate overnight; chill a beer can — it goes into the bird tomorrow

batch_prep.station: SUNDAY EARLY — FIRE SMOKER (start 8-9am for 2pm dinner)
tasks: Heat smoker to 275°F — apple or cherry wood chips; open beer can, pour out/drink half; lower chicken cavity onto can; stand upright on smoker grate; smoke 3.5–4 hrs until 165°F breast; baste with BBQ sauce last 30 min; rest 15 min tented before carving; NOTE: carve 1/4 of the bird for Sunday lunch lettuce wraps

batch_prep.station: BREVILLE OVEN — BATCH CHICKEN THIGHS (prep 15 min | roast 35 min)
tasks: 5 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs — pat dry; season with olive oil, lemon zest, garlic powder, oregano, salt, pepper; roast at 400°F for 30–35 min until 165°F internal; cool 10 min; slice or shred; divide into lunch containers (Mon–Sat); reserve ~10 oz UNCOOKED for Wed green curry dinner; reserve ~12 oz UNCOOKED for Sat souvlaki (skewer + marinate Sat morning)

batch_prep.station: OVEN — EGG BITES (prep 12 min | bake 20 min)
tasks: 12-cup muffin tin: whisk 8 eggs + 4 egg whites + 8 oz turkey sausage crumbles + 1 cup chopped asparagus tips + 4 sliced spring onions + 2 oz feta; add 1/2 tsp garlic powder + 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes + salt + pepper; fill cups 3/4 full; bake at 375°F for 18–20 min until puffed + set; cool fully; store airtight up to 5 days; Austin: 4 bites per morning | Cameron: 3 bites + optional avocado side
3 cups dry jasmine rice — makes ~7.5 cups cooked; used Mon–Thu dinners + Sun lunch wraps; Thu sesame rice: toss with 2 tsp sesame oil + 1 tsp soy sauce day-of
1 cup dry quinoa — cook + cool; store in container; NOT used this week — skip unless wanted for extra base option
PICKLED RADISH (Korean bowls Mon/Tue): 1 bunch radishes thinly sliced; toss with 3 tbsp rice vinegar + 1 tsp sugar + 1/2 tsp salt; rest 30 min; fridge up to 5 days
PICKLED CUCUMBER (teriyaki bowls Thu): 2 cucumbers, thin rounds; toss with 2 tbsp rice vinegar + 1 tsp sesame oil + 1/2 tsp salt + pinch sugar; fridge up to 3 days
KOREAN BBQ SAUCE (Mon/Tue lunch): 2 tbsp gochujang + 2 tbsp soy + 1 tbsp sesame oil + 1 tbsp honey + 1 tbsp rice vinegar + 1 clove garlic minced; whisk; jar it; fridge 1 week

THAI PEANUT SAUCE (Wed/Thu lunch): 3 tbsp peanut butter + 2 tbsp soy + 1 tbsp sesame oil + 1.5 tbsp lime juice + 1 tsp honey + 1 tsp grated ginger + Sriracha to taste; thin with 2 tbsp warm water; jar; fridge 1 week

RHUBARB COMPOTE (Sun): chop 2 rhubarb stalks into 1/2-inch pieces; cook with 1 tbsp honey + 1 tbsp water over medium 5-6 min until jammy; cool completely; store in jar; dollop into yogurt bowls morning-of

Portion Greek yogurt + protein powder into 4 meal prep containers; whisk smooth; refrigerate; add compote + strawberries + granola morning-of; Austin: + 1 tbsp almond butter + 1 tsp honey | Cameron: skip almond butter
2x Korean BBQ Chicken Bowl per person — Mon/Tue (label A or C)
2x Thai Peanut Soba Bowl per person — Wed/Thu
2x Arugula & Prosciutto Salad — Fri/Sat (assemble day-of; keep eggs + prosciutto separate)
1x Smoked Chicken Lettuce Wraps — Sun (assemble from Sunday smoker bird)
NEVER put avocado in any container labeled A — Austin allergy
Cameron avocados: store whole in fridge; slice fresh each day
